name: Betsukai (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Betsukai town emblem in maroon: a rounded stylised character with two ear-like points.
history: Municipal flag of Betsukai, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 25 June 1968.

features.role: Betsukai town emblem — a rounded stylised character with two ear-like points
